# Bundled dependencies

`pybind11/` contains the unmodified source archive for pybind11 v2.13.6,
including its BSD license. This version supports CPython 3.13 and is
bundled so configuring the SDK does not require a network connection.

- Source: https://github.com/pybind/pybind11/tree/v2.13.6
- Archive: https://github.com/pybind/pybind11/archive/refs/tags/v2.13.6.tar.gz
- Archive SHA-256: `e08cb87f4773da97fa7b5f035de8763abc656d87d5773e62f6da0587d1f0ec20`
